ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a ferocious “Other One” night with standout Dark Star, New Potato Caboose and a flawless Hey Jude encore.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the nonstop flow of this show – from a blistering opening The Other One through an incendiary Dark Star, soaring New Potato Caboose, and a scorching rendition of The Eleven – all wrapped up with a surprisingly tight Hey Jude encore.  The multitrack soundboard source is praised for its clean, crystal‑clear mix, making the band’s peak performance sparkle on every instrument.

ai_rating.rationale: Over two dozen uniformly 5‑star reviews praise both the musical execution and the pristine soundboard recording, leaving little doubt of an exceptional show and high‑quality source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multitrack soundboard praised as clean and crisp; a few listeners note minor tape hiss on older copies but the released version is described as “pure” and “high‑fidelity.”

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight a relentless, almost continuous flow – the band barely pauses between tunes, with seamless transitions (e.g., Stephen → The Eleven) that keep the energy at a fever pitch throughout both sets.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as ferocious on his SG, providing “propulsion” and perfect tone; his solo work is especially praised.
band_member_comments.Phil: Called “on fire,” matching Jerry note‑for‑note; many say this is his best show ever.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboard work gets a nod on the Hey Jude encore; otherwise no specific comments.
